task_description: Implement `legora scan` command: repository inventory collection (git ls-files), knowledge coverage mapping (covered/stale/uncovered), module-level grouping, human-readable + JSON output, CLI integration, and comprehensive unit tests.

verification.summary: npm run typecheck: 0 errors. npm test: 210/210 pass (15 new scan tests). npm run build: success. Tests cover all key scenarios: CURRENT->covered, STALE->stale, UNKNOWN->stale (fail-closed), no-reference->uncovered, module grouping, CLI integration with --json and --depth flags.
